title: osiris-mobile-termux: an Android/Termux research harness, Pixel Fold specification, and Smart Keyboard IntentPreviewFirewall (v0.5.0-edge-beta)
description:
v0.5.0-edge-beta ratifies the OSIRIS Google Pixel Fold Android Specification (OSIRIS-ANDROID-SPEC-001), integrating the Smart Keyboard IntentPreviewFirewall, Bluetooth SCO voice interaction service, and SYS-021 token-authenticated loopback bridge. Formalizes 46 architectural, security, and verification criteria aligned with the Pete Gordon live demo model and EXP-OLMO3 evidence.

osiris-mobile-termux is an execution harness that runs the OSIRIS research stack entirely on an Android device under Termux, with no cloud compute and no external model API. The harness contains no science: dnalang, organism_sim and osiris are installed editable from their own repositories and are never patched for mobile, so on-device numbers stay comparable to desktop numbers.

Engineering contributions. A tiered installer whose default (lite) compiles nothing but NumPy: dnalang declares qiskit>=1.3 but imports it lazily inside Circuit.to_qiskit, verified by blocking qiskit in sys.meta_path and importing the full artificial-life, classifier-system and neuro-symbolic-bridge path, so a 30-60 minute on-device Rust build is confined to an optional tier. A fold-aware tmux layout that migrates running panes with join-pane/break-pane on a session-scoped client-resized hook. A hysteretic battery and thermal governor (pause on battery below 20%, resume at 35%). An IntentPreviewFirewall intercepting input method events to enforce pre-dispatch AST validation under SYS-025.
